'''''Queen's Peril''''' is a [[canon]] young-adult novel written by [[E. K. Johnston]]. It is a prequel to the [[2019]] novel ''[[Queen's Shadow]]'', and it is set prior and concurrent to the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. The novel was published on [[June 2]], [[2020]] by [[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]], alongside an [[Queen's Peril (audiobook)|audiobook]] version.
